tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos srung la gnyer gtad bka' bsgo bzhugs so// oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā la pañtsa ra nā tha/ mā tri ma hā e ka dza ṭī shrī wan de wī i ṣu dha rū i shwa ra/ badzra kā la yakṣa/ badzra kā li yakṣe ṇi/ badzra yakṣa pu tra ye/ badzra ru tra bha ṭa ye/ badzra ru lu rakkha se/ seng ha mu kha/ adya mu kha/ ṛkṣa sa mu kha rakṣa sa mu kha sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa mā ya ma ti pra ma tha sa mā ya rakṣantu/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ shardha ka ra warmā/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan/ sga a gnyan dam pa kun dga' grags pa/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs chen po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa skya lo tsā ba chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ sngags 'chang sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/

rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bar du byon pa dang / gzhan yang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po kun bzang chos gyi nyi ma/ blo ldan shes rab kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchod ldan/ zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ bco brgyad chen mo mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal gnas gsar ba chen po 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'am/ mtshan gzhan 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug rgyal mtshan rab brtan dpal bzang po/ gzhan yang bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam grub/ brag rtsa rdo rje blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / lhag pa'i lha mchog bde kyai phur gsum la sogs pa'i bka' dang dam tshig zab mo la nye bar dgongs te dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po yum chen e ka dza ṭī/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ gsod byed gshin rje pu tra/ bdud chen mon bu bha ṭa/ kha 'bar srin mo ral gcig 'gugs byed seng ge'i gdong can/

'ching byed gzig gi gdong can/ sdom byed dom gyi gdong can/ myos byed dred kyi gdong can/ shugs 'dren bud med kyi tshogs/ g.yas ru skyes pa'i tshogs/ g.yon ru glang chen gyi tshogs/ rjes nyul sngags pa'i tshogs la sogs pa dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang bka' nyan dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa rin po che'i gdung brgyud sde dang bcas pa'i sbyin bdag chen po khal kha'i rdo rje thu/ she ye thu rgyal po/ sras po bgres pa tshe ring ye shes rdo rje/ gzhon pa tha'i ji mi 'gyur rdo rje/ dpon mo 'od zer skyid/ dpon mo so pa/ sras mo no yon khu ru re/ mchod gnas irthe ne/ jo bo'i gtsug lag khang bla ma grags pa dar rgyas sogs dge 'dun gyi sde blon 'bangs mnga' thang 'khor dang bcas pa la phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du 'go zhing chas pa dang / bsrung skyabs sba ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams la rlung mkhris bad kan/ 'dus pa/ dus min/ gnyen rims bsam ngan dug rigs sogs nad thams cad dang / lha klu gza' bdud rgyal btsan ma mo sogs gdon gyi rigs dang / lo zla zhag kag sogs kag ngan gyi rigs dang / che sri chung sri sogs sri'i rigs dang / rbad 'dre rbod gtong sogs gzhan gyi gnod sems kyi rigs dang / thog ser sa g.yos sogs 'byung ba'i gnod pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dgra jag chom rkun sogs mdor na 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi bar mdzod cig sku tshe ring ba sku bsod rgyal brgyud chos brgyud 'bangs brgyud rta phyugs kyi brgyud sogs dar zhing / nor bu rin po che'i rigs 'bru gos dar go mtshon sogs longs spyod rnams dang / lha sde mi sde zad mi shes par dgyes par mdzod cig snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba sde dang bcas pa dbang du bsdu bar mdzod cig

sngon las 'phral rkyen las gyur pa'i dgra 'dre byur sogs gnod byed thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis gdul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi bas 'dul ba mi nus pa rnams drag po mngon spyod kyi las kyis lo zla ma 'gyangs par tshar gcod par mdzod cig byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems lung rtogs yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas te myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas sems can thams cad la grub gnyis bde blag tu stsol ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzod cig mdor na sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa legs tshogs ji snyed kun/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /shu bhaṃ// //zhes pa dpal sa skya'i gzhi thog pho brang nas sa skya pa kun blos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ chos srung la gnyer gtad bka' bsgo/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
